name: DEM scenario E — a cloud security-policy change immediately precedes the synthetic failure: the policy hypothesis is raised, the verdict stays suspected
comment: Owner Phase O scenario E. The change record satisfies sg-nacl-block's supporting clause (0.50 -> 0.55, into the visible top-K) but the signature still demands a passive_flow witness — a flow-log REJECT on the failing 5-tuple — which no source supplies. A change proves policy was edited, not that the edit is dropping traffic, so precedence in time can never confirm. The object's own verdict remains the single-modality app-experience suspicion.
